tools.description: Search MITOMAP mtDNA variants by locus (MT-TL1, MT-ATP6, MT-CR...), disease text, MITOMAP status category and/or an rCRS position range. record_type defaults to disease_mutation (MITOMAP's coding/control and rRNA/tRNA mutation lists); use polymorphism or any for population polymorphisms. Unknown loci are rejected. Ordered by position, or by MITOMAP reference count with sort_by='reference_count' (most-published first); returns results with total/truncated/next_offset. Signature: search_variants(locus=, disease_query=, status=, record_type=, position_start=, position_end=, sort_by=, limit=, offset=, response_mode=).

disease_query.description: Case-insensitive substring of MITOMAP's disease text, e.g. 'Leigh', 'LHON', 'MELAS'. Up to 5 alternatives (any matches) separated by '|', ' / ' or ' OR ': Leigh|NARP|MILS.

status.description: MITOMAP status category: reported, confirmed (Cfrm), conflicting_reports, unclear.

sort_by.description: position (default, rCRS order) or reference_count (most MITOMAP-cited first; ties by position).

offset.description: Rows to skip (default 0).

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal (ids, locus, disease, status) | compact (default; + alleles, plasmy, GenBank counts, reference_count) | standard (get_variant: + up to 10 references with fenced titles; search_variants: + up to 10 PMIDs) | full (get_variant: + up to 50 references and every PMID; search_variants: + every PMID).

tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: Read this first in a cold session. Returns server/tool metadata: supported assemblies (GRCh38 default, GRCh37), input formats (coordinate, rsID, HGVS, SPDI, CNV), the VEP-option allowlist, the four response_mode tiers, the deterministic error codes, the citation contract, a capabilities_version hash a warm client can compare to skip re-fetching, and a live `upstream` health summary (per-assembly Ensembl REST status from the circuit breaker). No upstream call.

tools.name: resolve_variant
tools.description: Use this when the caller's variant is an rsID, HGVS, SPDI, or loosely formatted: returns a results[] list (one entry per ALT allele) with the canonical CHR-POS-REF-ALT variant_id, gene_symbol and most_severe_consequence that the annotation tools build on, plus a top-level warnings[] (a multi-allelic input carries a multiple_alts warning). Coordinates are normalized locally; rsIDs/HGVS are recoded via Ensembl. Cheap (<1kB). Then call annotate_variant for the full VEP annotation.

variant.description: A variant in any supported form: CHR-POS-REF-ALT, an rsID (e.g. rs6025), genomic/transcript HGVS, or SPDI.

assembly.description: Reference build for resolution. GRCh38 default.

allele.description: Optional ALT filter for a multi-allelic input: an ALT base (e.g. 'A') or a full CHR-POS-REF-ALT. Omit to return every ALT allele in results[].

tools.name: recode_variant
tools.description: Use this to translate a variant (or a batch, cap 200) between identifier systems -- rsID <-> HGVS (g./c./p./t.) <-> VCF string <-> SPDI -- without a full VEP annotation. Returns one result object per input. Use the optional fields filter to trim the payload to just the representations you need.

variants.description: One or more variants (rsID, HGVS, coordinate, or SPDI) to recode into every equivalent representation. Cap 200.

assembly.description: Reference build for recoding. GRCh38 default.

fields.description: Optional comma-separated projection filter over the closed vocabulary vcf_string, hgvsg, hgvsc, hgvsp, spdi (e.g. 'hgvsg,spdi,vcf_string'); omit for the full set. An unknown field is rejected as invalid_input (it is not silently dropped).

tools.name: annotate_variant
tools.description: Use this for the full VEP annotation of one variant: consequences, gene/transcript impact, HGVS, MANE/canonical flags, SIFT/PolyPhen, plus variant-level CADD/GERP under position_scores and per-transcript REVEL/AlphaMissense, and gnomAD frequencies. Input is parsed, recoded if needed, sent to the VEP region endpoint, then shaped to response_mode (start compact; widen to standard/full only if needed). The standard tier filters noisy neighbour transcripts by default (set transcripts='all' for every isoform). Carries a provenance block (endpoint + citation) and _meta.next_commands follow-ups.

variant.description: A single variant (coordinate, rsID, HGVS, SPDI, or CNV) to annotate with the Ensembl Variant Effect Predictor.

assembly.description: Reference build for annotation. GRCh38 default.

response_mode.description: Verbosity tier: minimal (identity only), compact (default; representative transcript + frequencies), standard (filtered transcripts), or full (raw-ish payload). Position scores (CADD/GERP) appear once under position_scores at all tiers above minimal.

transcripts.description: standard-tier only: 'auto' (default) drops uninformative MODIFIER neighbour transcripts, collapses identical-effect isoforms (equivalent_transcript_ids), and caps to the most severe; 'all' returns every transcript uncollapsed. Each variant carries its own transcripts_summary {shown,collapsed,total} when filtered.

allele.description: Optional ALT filter for a multi-allelic input: an ALT base (e.g. 'A') or a full CHR-POS-REF-ALT. Omit to annotate every ALT allele (each as an entry in results[]).

vep_options.description: Optional VEP flag overrides (keys must be in the allowlist; call get_capabilities for the set). Plugins like SpliceAI / dbNSFP are instance-dependent.

tools.name: annotate_variants_batch
tools.description: Use this to annotate many variants (cap 200) in one call instead of looping annotate_variant. Returns a results list (each shaped to response_mode and tagged with its original input; a multi-allelic input such as rs6025 yields one result per ALT allele), a per-input errors list (parse/not-found failures that did not fail the batch), and a summary (requested/annotated/failed count inputs; result_rows counts result rows). Inputs still unresolved at the batch deadline (default 48 s) come back as per-input upstream_timeout errors next to the finished results; retry those alone. Each result's standard-tier transcript list is filtered by default; per-result truncation is reported in that result's transcripts_summary.

variants.description: Up to 200 variants to annotate in one call. Repeated inputs are annotated once; one bad or slow variant never fails the batch (its error is collected per-input).

assembly.description: Reference build for annotation. GRCh38 default.

response_mode.description: Verbosity tier applied to every result (default compact).

transcripts.description: standard-tier only: 'auto' (default) filters/caps each result's transcripts; 'all' returns every transcript. Each result carries its own transcripts_summary when truncated.

vep_options.description: Optional VEP flag overrides (keys must be in the allowlist).

tools.name: liftover_variant
tools.description: Use this to map a genomic coordinate (CHR-POS-REF-ALT) from one human assembly to the other (GRCh37 <-> GRCh38) via the Ensembl assembly-map endpoint. The two assemblies must differ. A unique mapping returns the lifted coordinate; zero mappings -> not_found, multiple -> ambiguous. HGVS/rsID inputs are unsupported (resolve_variant them first).

variant.description: A genomic coordinate (CHR-POS-REF-ALT) to lift between assemblies. HGVS/rsID are not liftable -- resolve them first.

from_assembly.description: Source assembly of the input coordinate.

to_assembly.description: Target assembly to lift the coordinate to (must differ from from_assembly).

tools.name: check_upstream_health
tools.description: Use this to check whether the Ensembl REST hosts are healthy before a batch, or when calls start failing. Runs a live /info/ping of both assemblies (GRCh38 rest.ensembl.org, GRCh37 grch37.rest.ensembl.org) and returns each host's status (ok | recovering | down), circuit state, reachability, latency, and last error. If one build is degraded, route to the healthy one or back off. Returns <1kB.

tools.name: search_panels
tools.description: Search PanelApp panels by name, relevant disorders, or disease group across UK + Australia (region='both' default), deduped and ranked. Use it to find a panel_id, then page via _meta.next_commands.

query.description: Free-text search over panel name, relevant disorders, and disease group (word-prefix match; empty returns all).

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal | compact | standard | full (default compact).

offset.description: 0-based offset into the result set; prefer truncated.next_cursor.

cursor.description: Opaque page token from a prior truncated.next_cursor; pass it to continue paging (rejected as invalid_input only if malformed).

tools.name: get_panel
tools.description: Return one panel's detail plus its entity-count breakdown. region must be a single concrete region ('uk' or 'australia'), not 'both'.

panel_id.description: PanelApp panel id (region-scoped, positive integer, e.g. 285).

region.description: uk (Genomics England) | australia. Panel ids are per-region; not 'both'.

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal | compact | standard | full (default compact).

tools.name: get_panel_genes
tools.description: Return a panel's entities (genes by default; or region | str | all), filtered by min_confidence (green = green only; amber = amber+green; red = all). region must be concrete; widen response_mode for phenotypes/evidence.

panel_id.description: PanelApp panel id (region-scoped, positive integer, e.g. 285).

region.description: uk (Genomics England) | australia. Panel ids are per-region; not 'both'.

min_confidence.description: green | amber | red rank floor; default no filter.

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal | compact | standard | full (default compact).

offset.description: 0-based offset into the result set; prefer truncated.next_cursor.

cursor.description: Opaque page token from a prior truncated.next_cursor; pass it to continue paging (rejected as invalid_input only if malformed).

tools.name: get_gene_panels
tools.description: Return every panel a gene appears on across regions, sorted by confidence. Query by gene_symbol (required); hgnc_id is an OPTIONAL result filter, not a standalone query.

gene_symbol.description: Approved gene symbol (e.g. PKD1). Required: PanelApp queries by symbol; an HGNC, Ensembl or NCBI Gene id is rejected with the call that converts it.

hgnc_id.description: HGNC CURIE (e.g. HGNC:1100). OPTIONAL filter over the hits -- it cannot stand alone as a query; pass gene_symbol.

min_confidence.description: green | amber | red rank floor; default no filter.

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal | compact | standard | full (default compact).

tools.name: resolve_gene
tools.description: Resolve free text or an approved symbol to a single rolled-up PanelApp gene. The gene reports its symbol, hgnc id, panel count, regions, and max_confidence_label (the strongest traffic-light label across panels); matches[] always holds exactly that one gene. Pass query (an approved symbol or free text). PanelApp indexes genes by symbol, so an HGNC id is not a lookup key here. region (uk|australia|both, default both) scopes the lookup. Follow up with get_gene_panels to list the panels it appears on.

query.description: Approved gene symbol or free text to resolve to one rolled-up gene (e.g. SCN1A). An HGNC, Ensembl or NCBI Gene id is not a lookup key here: it is rejected with the call that converts it.

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal | compact | standard | full (default compact).

tools.name: compare_panels
tools.description: Diff genes across 2-5 panels server-side: shared genes, genes unique to each panel, and per-panel confidence deltas. Pass concrete-region refs ({panel_id, region}); 'both' is rejected. Cheaper than pulling each panel's full gene list and diffing in context.

min_confidence.description: green | amber | red rank floor; default no filter.

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal | compact | standard | full (default compact).

PanelRef.description:
One compare_panels panel reference: a panel id plus its region.

PanelApp panel ids are per-region (UK panel 285 is a different panel from
Australia panel 285), so each ref carries its own concrete region -- 'both' is
not a namespace a panel id can live in.

This docstring is advertised verbatim as the JSON-Schema description of a
panels[] item; keep it plain prose an agent can act on.

panel_id.description: PanelApp panel id (region-scoped, positive integer, e.g. 285).

tools.name: get_panels_for_genes
tools.description: Batch gene->panel membership for up to 20 gene symbols in one call: per gene, the panel_count, max_confidence_label, and panels it appears on. Unknown symbols are returned in not_found; over-cap input is truncated.

gene_symbols.description: Approved gene symbols (e.g. PKD1); capped at 20 per call. An HGNC, Ensembl or NCBI Gene id is listed under `unsupported` with the call that converts it.

min_confidence.description: green | amber | red rank floor; default no filter.

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal | compact | standard | full (default compact).

tools.name: get_server_capabilities
tools.description: Return the PanelApp-Link tool inventory, vocabulary (confidence labels and ranks, entity types, regions), response modes, recommended workflows, error codes, resources, and live data freshness. Compare `capabilities_version` to skip re-fetching when unchanged.

tools.name: get_panelapp_diagnostics
tools.description: Report live backend status: the data mode (live), the upstream PanelApp source URLs (UK + Australia), the in-memory cache TTL, current cache stats, and the RED metrics snapshot (request/error counts, cache hit ratio, tool + per-region upstream duration p50/p95/p99 -- also exported as Prometheus text at GET /metrics). Also echoes server_version and capabilities_version so a warm client can poll this small payload for drift instead of re-fetching full capabilities.

upstream.description: Per-region upstream fetch timing for this call ({calls, ms}).

data_freshness.description: Panel-list generation freshness and background refresh state.

data.description: Live backend status, cache stats, and the RED metrics snapshot.

refresh.description: Panel-list generation freshness and background refresh state.

tools.name: get_server_capabilities
tools.description: Return the mondo-link discovery surface: identity/build/Mondo release, the tool list WITH call signatures, response modes, recommended workflows, the cross-reference predicate ranking, the error taxonomy, and limits. detail='full' adds the full policy notes. Call this first in a cold session, or read mondo://tools / mondo://capabilities. Signature: get_server_capabilities(detail=).

detail.description: summary (default, light) or full (adds policy notes).

tools.name: get_diagnostics
tools.description: Report the local Mondo index status: whether the data is built, the loaded Mondo release version, term/obsolete/xref/closure counts, schema version, and when it was built, plus a runtime block (request/error counts and latency percentiles p50/p95/p99). Use this to confirm freshness or diagnose an upstream_unavailable error. Signature: get_diagnostics().

tools.name: resolve_disease
tools.description: Resolve a disease label, synonym, MONDO id, or external cross-reference CURIE (OMIM/Orphanet/DOID/...) to the canonical Mondo term {mondo_id, name, match_type} and germline causal genes (Mondo assertion). causal_genes [{hgnc_id, symbol}] are Mondo's has_material_basis_in_germline_mutation_in assertions for mostly monogenic diseases, not a gene-disease validity curation (use GenCC/ClinGen for that); next_commands chain to hgnc_resolve_symbol for the gene's band and details. A term with no gene of its own lists its descendants' genes (at most 20), each with from_descendant=<child MONDO id>. causal_genes: [] means Mondo asserts none; the field is absent only when the loaded data predates the gene table. A near-miss or acronym-like label falls back to a conservative fuzzy match (match_type='fuzzy'). The strongest match type wins (primary label > exact synonym > related synonym); only a tie returns ambiguous_query with candidates, each carrying match_type and score; an obsolete id returns not_found with its successor. Signature: resolve_disease(query, response_mode=).

query.description: A disease label, synonym, a MONDO id (MONDO:0008426 or 0008426), or a cross-reference CURIE (OMIM:182212, Orphanet:2462, DOID:...).

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal|compact|standard|full (default compact).

tools.name: search_diseases
tools.description: Full-text search over Mondo disease names, synonyms, and definitions (FTS, relevance-ranked); returns {mondo_id, name, score} -- compact adds a short definition_snippet; standard/full add the complete definition -- plus a pagination block {total, returned, limit, offset, truncated, next_offset}. When truncated, next_commands carries a forward-page step (offset advanced) and a widen step. Obsolete terms are excluded unless include_obsolete=true. Signature: search_diseases(query, limit=, offset=, include_obsolete=, response_mode=).

query.description: A disease label, synonym, a MONDO id (MONDO:0008426 or 0008426), or a cross-reference CURIE (OMIM:182212, Orphanet:2462, DOID:...).

offset.description: Rows to skip for forward paging (default 0).

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal|compact|standard|full (default compact).

tools.name: get_disease
tools.description: Return a Mondo disease term: definition, synonyms, grouped cross-references, direct parents and children, top-level groupings, subsets, obsolescence (replaced_by/consider), and germline causal genes (Mondo assertion). causal_genes [{hgnc_id, symbol}] are Mondo's has_material_basis_in_germline_mutation_in assertions for mostly monogenic diseases, not a gene-disease validity curation (use GenCC/ClinGen for that); next_commands chain to hgnc_resolve_symbol for the gene's band and details. A term with no gene of its own lists its descendants' genes (at most 20), each with from_descendant=<child MONDO id>. causal_genes: [] means Mondo asserts none; the field is absent only when the loaded data predates the gene table. The term accepts a MONDO id, a label/synonym, or an external xref CURIE (resolved first). Pass fields=['xrefs.OMIM', ...] for a sparse projection. Signature: get_disease(term, response_mode=, fields=).

term.description: A MONDO id (MONDO:0008426 or 0008426), a disease label/synonym, or an external xref CURIE that resolves to a single Mondo term.

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal|compact|standard|full (default compact).

fields.description: Sparse fieldset: return ONLY these top-level keys (dot into a grouped object, e.g. 'xrefs.OMIM'). Identity anchors (mondo_id, name, mondo_version) are always included. Omit for the full payload.

tools.name: get_disease_ancestors
tools.description: Return all transitive is_a ancestors (broader diseases) of a Mondo term via the precomputed closure, with a pagination block {total, returned, limit, offset, truncated, next_offset}. When truncated, next_commands carries a forward-page step (offset) so you can walk a >limit closure without re-sending rows. Use get_disease_parents for only the immediate parents. Signature: get_disease_ancestors(term, limit=, offset=, response_mode=).

term.description: A MONDO id (MONDO:0008426 or 0008426), a disease label/synonym, or an external xref CURIE that resolves to a single Mondo term.

offset.description: Rows to skip for forward paging (default 0).

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal|compact|standard|full (default compact).

tools.name: get_disease_descendants
tools.description: Return all transitive is_a descendants (more specific diseases) of a Mondo term via the precomputed closure, with a pagination block {total, returned, limit, offset, truncated, next_offset}. When truncated, next_commands carries a forward-page step (offset) so you can walk a >limit closure without re-sending rows. Use get_disease_children for only the immediate children. Signature: get_disease_descendants(term, limit=, offset=, response_mode=).

term.description: A MONDO id (MONDO:0008426 or 0008426), a disease label/synonym, or an external xref CURIE that resolves to a single Mondo term.

offset.description: Rows to skip for forward paging (default 0).

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal|compact|standard|full (default compact).

tools.name: get_disease_parents
tools.description: Return the direct is_a parents (immediate broader diseases) of a Mondo term. Use get_disease_ancestors for the full transitive set. Signature: get_disease_parents(term, response_mode=).

term.description: A MONDO id (MONDO:0008426 or 0008426), a disease label/synonym, or an external xref CURIE that resolves to a single Mondo term.

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal|compact|standard|full (default compact).

tools.name: get_disease_children
tools.description: Return the direct is_a children (immediate more-specific diseases) of a Mondo term. Use get_disease_descendants for the full transitive set. Signature: get_disease_children(term, response_mode=).

term.description: A MONDO id (MONDO:0008426 or 0008426), a disease label/synonym, or an external xref CURIE that resolves to a single Mondo term.

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal|compact|standard|full (default compact).

tools.name: resolve_xref
tools.description: Resolve an external cross-reference CURIE (OMIM/Orphanet/DOID/NCIT/UMLS/MeSH/MedGen/SNOMED/GARD/ONCOTREE) back to the Mondo term(s) that map to it, ranked by mapping predicate (exactMatch > equivalentTo > closeMatch > ...). Returns matches[] plus a pagination block {total, returned, limit, offset, truncated, next_offset}; when truncated, next_commands carries a forward-page step (offset). Signature: resolve_xref(xref_id, limit=, offset=, response_mode=).

xref_id.description: An external cross-reference CURIE (prefix:local), e.g. OMIM/Orphanet/DOID, to resolve back to the Mondo term(s) that map to it.

offset.description: Rows to skip for forward paging (default 0).

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal|compact|standard|full (default compact).

tools.name: map_cross_ontology
tools.description: List a Mondo term's cross-references to other ontologies, grouped by target prefix. get_disease surfaces every source; this tool's `prefixes` filter is the first-class set (OMIM/ORPHA/DOID/NCIT/UMLS/MESH/MEDGEN/SCTID/GARD/ONCOTREE), each with its mapping predicate and origin (obo_xref|sssom). An unrecognised prefix is rejected with invalid_input. Signature: map_cross_ontology(term, prefixes=, response_mode=).

term.description: A MONDO id (MONDO:0008426 or 0008426), a disease label/synonym, or an external xref CURIE that resolves to a single Mondo term.

prefixes.description: Restrict to these first-class cross-reference sources (OMIM/ORPHA/DOID/NCIT/UMLS/MESH/MEDGEN/SCTID/GARD/ONCOTREE). An unrecognised prefix is rejected with invalid_input. Omit to return every source.

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal|compact|standard|full (default compact).

tools.name: resolve_disease_batch
tools.description: Resolve many labels/ids/xrefs in one call (partial success: each item returns its resolution {mondo_id, name, match_type} or its own ok=false/error_code/message; the call never fails wholesale). Every row carries its `index` (0-based, 1:1 with the input) so results key back uniformly regardless of ok. Max 50 items; compact per item. Signature: resolve_disease_batch(queries, response_mode=).

queries.description: 1..50 disease labels/synonyms, MONDO ids, or xref CURIEs.

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal|compact|standard|full (default compact).

tools.name: get_disease_batch
tools.description: Fetch many disease records in one call (partial success per item: each row is the record or its own ok=false/error_code/message). Each term accepts a MONDO id, label, or xref CURIE; pass fields=[...] for a sparse projection. Every row carries its `index` (0-based, 1:1 with the input). Max 50 items; compact per item. Signature: get_disease_batch(terms, response_mode=, fields=).

terms.description: 1..50 MONDO ids, disease labels/synonyms, or xref CURIEs.

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal|compact|standard|full (default compact).

fields.description: Sparse fieldset: return ONLY these top-level keys (dot into a grouped object, e.g. 'xrefs.OMIM'). Identity anchors (mondo_id, name, mondo_version) are always included. Omit for the full payload.

tools.name: get_server_capabilities
tools.description: Return the mavedb-link discovery surface: identity/build, the tool list WITH call signatures, response modes, recommended workflows, the MaveDB identifier scheme, the error taxonomy, and limits. detail='full' adds the full policy notes. Call this first in a cold session, or read mavedb://tools / mavedb://capabilities. Signature: get_server_capabilities(detail=).

detail.description: summary (default, light) or full (adds policy notes).

tools.name: get_diagnostics
tools.description: Report upstream MaveDB API reachability and version (live check of GET /api/version), the configured base URL, this build's provenance, and a runtime block (request/error counts and latency percentiles p50/p95/p99). Use this to confirm the API is up or diagnose an upstream_unavailable error. Signature: get_diagnostics().

tools.name: search_score_sets
tools.description: Search MaveDB score sets (the datasets carrying scored variants) by free text and facets — target gene(s), organism, target type, and author. Returns score-set hits {urn, title, num_variants, targets, license, ...} plus a pagination block. Organism/target-type facets are null-inclusive by default (records with unknown metadata are KEPT and _meta.facet_excluded reports the drops); pass facet_mode='strict' to also drop unknown-metadata records. This is the MaveDB front door. Signature: search_score_sets(text=, targets=, target_organism_names=, target_types=, authors=, facet_mode=, published=, limit=, offset=, response_mode=).

text.description: Free-text query over gene/target, title, and abstract.

targets.description: Filter to score sets whose target gene is one of these HGNC symbols (server-side facet).

target_organism_names.description: Filter to these target organisms (client-side, null-inclusive). Use full scientific names.

target_types.description: Filter to these MaveDB target categories (client-side, null-inclusive). Closed set: protein_coding | regulatory | other_noncoding (the exact values the runtime accepts; an unlisted value is invalid_input, never a silent-empty result).

authors.description: Filter to score sets with these author name substrings (case-insensitive).

offset.description: Rows to skip for forward paging (default 0).

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal|compact|standard|full (default compact).

tools.name: get_score_set
tools.description: Return a MaveDB score-set record by URN: title, description, target gene(s) with external IDs, parent experiment, publications, the per-record license, variant count, and (standard/full) dataset columns and method/abstract text. Get the actual scores with get_variant_scores. Signature: get_score_set(urn, response_mode=).

urn.description: A MaveDB score-set URN ('urn:mavedb:00000001-a-1'). Find one via search_score_sets or get_gene_score_sets.

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal|compact|standard|full (default compact).

tools.name: get_variant_scores
tools.description: Return the quantitative variant-by-variant score table for a score set (urn:mavedb:...-a-1) as parsed rows: each row carries accession, variant_index (numeric join key for get_mapped_variants), HGVS (hgvs_nt/hgvs_splice/hgvs_pro), the numeric score (+ derived classification when calibrated), and score-set specific columns. Paged via offset/limit; NA values become null. Page forward with offset=next_offset. For large pulls use response_mode='minimal' to drop the HGVS columns to {accession, variant_index, score, classification} (token-safe); a full ~1000-row page at standard can exceed the MCP token cap and be auto-saved to a tool-results file — page via offset or use get_score_distribution for summary statistics instead. The top-level calibrations threshold ladder is record-level data shipped once (the first page, start=0) or at full — not re-sent on every forward page; the per-row classification rides on every page. full also adds dataset_columns (which CSV columns are scores vs counts). Signature: get_variant_scores(urn, offset=, limit=, drop_na_columns=, response_mode=).

urn.description: A MaveDB score-set URN ('urn:mavedb:00000001-a-1'). Find one via search_score_sets or get_gene_score_sets.

offset.description: Rows to skip in the score table (default 0); `start` is accepted as a start alias for compatibility with MaveDB's upstream scores endpoint.

drop_na_columns.description: Drop columns that are entirely NA (default false).

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal|compact|standard|full (default compact).

tools.name: get_variant_score
tools.description: Look up the functional score for ONE variant without paging the whole table. Pass a full variant URN (urn:mavedb:...-a-1#2) to resolve it directly, OR a score-set URN plus hgvs= (e.g. 'c.8168A>G' or 'p.Arg1699Trp') to scan that score set's table for the matching row(s). BOTH paths return the same shape: {urn, query, resolved_by, match_count, results:[{variant_urn, variant_index, hgvs_nt, hgvs_pro, score, classifications?}], calibrations?}. mapped_variants are opt-in (standard/full) and current-only unless full. The fast path for 'what is the score (and calibrated class) for this variant?'. Signature: get_variant_score(urn, hgvs=, response_mode=).

urn.description: EITHER a full variant URN ('urn:mavedb:00000001-a-1#2', resolved directly) OR a score-set URN ('urn:mavedb:00000001-a-1', used WITH hgvs=). The first example is a full variant URN so a bare urn= call resolves; pass hgvs= alongside when urn= is a score-set URN.

hgvs.description: HGVS string (hgvs_nt or hgvs_pro) to match when urn is a score-set URN; omit when urn is a full variant URN. Accession-prefix insensitive: a bare 'c.8168A>G' resolves a stored 'ENST00000380152.8:c.8168A>G' and vice-versa. Note: many SGE sets leave hgvs_pro null, so a p. form may not match there — use the c. form.

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal|compact|standard|full (default compact).

tools.name: get_score_distribution
tools.description: Summarise a score set's score distribution server-side (MaveDB has no stats endpoint): n, min/max, mean, median, quartiles, stdev, and a 10-bin histogram — a compact summary INSTEAD of paging the whole table. Pass score= to locate that value (its percentile + calibrated classification). Carries the calibration thresholds when present. Signature: get_score_distribution(urn, score=, response_mode=).

urn.description: A MaveDB score-set URN ('urn:mavedb:00000001-a-1'). Find one via search_score_sets or get_gene_score_sets.

score.description: A score to locate within the distribution (percentile + class).

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal|compact|standard|full (default compact).

tools.name: get_mapped_variants
tools.description: Return the genome-mapped GA4GH VRS alleles for a score set's variants (urn:mavedb:...-a-1), each with its source variant URN, variant_index, VRS allele id, ClinGen Allele ID, and current flag — the bridge from assay coordinates to reference-genome/clinical coordinates. Rows are ordered numerically by variant_index to match get_variant_scores, but JOIN on variant_urn/variant_index (do not zip by row — some variants are unmapped). MaveDB serves only each variant's current mapping, so current_only=false returns the same rows (kept for compatibility). Paged via offset/limit. Signature: get_mapped_variants(urn, current_only=, limit=, offset=, response_mode=).

urn.description: A MaveDB score-set URN ('urn:mavedb:00000001-a-1'). Find one via search_score_sets or get_gene_score_sets.

current_only.description: No effect: MaveDB serves only the current mapping per variant, so false returns the same rows (kept for compatibility).

offset.description: Rows to skip for forward paging (default 0).

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal|compact|standard|full (default compact).

tools.name: get_gene_score_sets
tools.description: Resolve an HGNC gene symbol (e.g. BRCA1) to its gene identity (name, HGNC id, location) AND every published MaveDB score set that targets it — the COMPLETE set, unioned from HGNC resolution and the target-name facet and deduped by URN (see the coverage block). The fastest complete way to find all MAVE data for a gene. Paged via offset/limit. Signature: get_gene_score_sets(gene_symbol, limit=, offset=, response_mode=).

gene_symbol.description: An HGNC gene symbol (e.g. BRCA1, TP53, PTEN).

offset.description: Score sets to skip for paging (default 0).

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal|compact|standard|full (default compact).

tools.name: get_experiment
tools.description: Return a MaveDB experiment record by URN (urn:mavedb:00000001-a): title, description, parent experiment set, the child score-set URNs, keywords, and publications. An experiment groups one or more score sets from one assay context. Open a child dataset with get_score_set. Signature: get_experiment(urn, response_mode=).

urn.description: A MaveDB experiment URN ('urn:mavedb:00000001-a'). Groups one or more score sets; find one via a score set's experiment_urn.

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal|compact|standard|full (default compact).

tools.name: search_experiments
tools.description: Search MaveDB experiments by free text (author facet, plus target facets — targets/target_organism_names/target_types — derived from the score-set search and grouped by parent experiment). A gene-token query re-ranks experiments whose score sets target the gene above abstract namesakes (reranked_by:'target_gene'). Returns experiment hits {urn, score_set_urns, ...} plus a pagination block (paged client-side). Use search_score_sets when you want datasets/scores; use this for the assay-context grouping. Signature: search_experiments(text=, targets=, target_organism_names=, target_types=, authors=, published=, limit=, offset=, response_mode=).

text.description: Free-text query over gene/target, title, and abstract.

targets.description: Filter to score sets whose target gene is one of these HGNC symbols (server-side facet).

target_organism_names.description: Filter to these target organisms (client-side, null-inclusive). Use full scientific names.

target_types.description: Filter to these MaveDB target categories (client-side, null-inclusive). Closed set: protein_coding | regulatory | other_noncoding (the exact values the runtime accepts; an unlisted value is invalid_input, never a silent-empty result).

authors.description: Filter to score sets with these author name substrings (case-insensitive).

offset.description: Rows to skip for forward paging (default 0).

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal|compact|standard|full (default compact).

tools.name: get_collection
tools.description: Return a curated MaveDB collection by URN: its name, description, badge, num_score_sets/num_experiments, and the member experiment and score-set URNs. Collections group related datasets (e.g. by gene, consortium, or theme). The member lists are PAGED (limit/offset, truncated/next_offset) so large collections stay light. Open a member with get_score_set. Signature: get_collection(urn, limit=, offset=, response_mode=).

urn.description: A MaveDB collection URN ('urn:mavedb:collection-<uuid>'). Obtain one from a member score set's official_collections (get_score_set at standard/full).

offset.description: Members to skip for forward paging (default 0).

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal|compact|standard|full (default compact).

tools.name: find_variant
tools.description: Find ONE variant across EVERY MaveDB score set — the same variant's functional measurements wherever it was assayed (the cross-dataset rollup for 'every assay that measured this variant'). Pass variant= in ANY form (auto-detected): a VRS id (ga4gh:VA…), a variant URN ('urn:mavedb:…-a-1#2', resolved to its VRS internally so you do NOT map it first — chain straight from get_variant_score), or a bare HGVS string (+ optional gene_symbol=), resolved to its VRS internally — no map-first round-trip. Each hit carries its score_set_urn, variant_urn, ClinGen Allele ID, and (when enrich=true, default) the score + calibrated classifications. ClinGen Allele IDs are not accepted upstream; pass the variant URN instead. Paged via offset/limit. Signature: find_variant(variant, gene_symbol=, only_current=, enrich=, limit=, offset=, response_mode=).

variant.description: The variant to look up, in ANY of three forms (auto-detected): a GA4GH VRS allele id ('ga4gh:VA…'), a full variant URN ('urn:mavedb:00000001-a-1#2'), or a bare HGVS string ('p.Asp2723His', 'NM_000059.4:c.8167G>A' — pass gene_symbol= alongside so it can resolve). vrs_id/variant_urn/hgvs are accepted as aliases.

gene_symbol.description: HGNC gene symbol that scopes an hgvs= lookup (required when the HGVS is not in the mirror and must be resolved live). Ignored unless hgvs= is set. `gene` is accepted as a compatibility alias.

only_current.description: No effect: MaveDB serves only current genome mappings, so false returns the same hits (kept for compatibility).

enrich.description: Attach each hit's score + classifications (default true).

offset.description: Rows to skip for forward paging (default 0).

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal|compact|standard|full (default compact).

tools.name: get_hgvs_validation
tools.description: Validate an HGVS variant string against MaveDB's validator. Returns {variant, valid, message}: a valid string -> valid=true; a parseable-but-wrong one -> valid=false WITH the upstream reason (e.g. reference-base disagreement, missing transcript accession) so you can fix it before a lookup fails. Not a normalizer. Signature: get_hgvs_validation(variant, response_mode=).

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal|compact|standard|full (default compact).

tools.name: get_classified_variants
tools.description: Return a score set's variants grouped into a calibrated functional class — e.g. every 'abnormal' (PS3) or 'normal' (BS3) variant — without paging the whole table. Resolves the primary calibration (or a given calibration_urn); filter with classification=abnormal|normal|not_specified (omit for all). Each variant carries its score, HGVS, class label, and ACMG criterion. Paged via offset/limit. response_mode='full' adds the calibration threshold ladder (calibration). Signature: get_classified_variants(urn, classification=, calibration_urn=, limit=, offset=, response_mode=).

urn.description: A MaveDB score-set URN that carries a functional-classification calibration ('urn:mavedb:00000013-a-1'). Uncalibrated sets yield not_found -- confirm via get_score_set (score_calibrations present).

classification.description: Filter to one functional class (omit for all).

calibration_urn.description: A specific calibration URN; omit to use the primary calibration.

offset.description: Rows to skip for forward paging (default 0).

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal|compact|standard|full (default compact).

tools.name: get_server_capabilities
tools.description: Return the hpo-link discovery surface: identity/build/HPO release, the tool list WITH call signatures, response modes, recommended workflows, the xref prefixes, the error taxonomy, and limits. detail='full' adds the full policy notes. Call this first in a cold session, or read hpo://tools / hpo://capabilities. Signature: get_server_capabilities(detail=).

detail.description: summary (default, light) or full (adds policy notes).

tools.name: get_diagnostics
tools.description: Report the local HPO index status: whether the data is built, the loaded HPO and HPOA release versions, term/obsolete/closure/xref/annotation counts, when it was built, and a runtime block (request/error counts and latency percentiles p50/p95/p99). Use this to confirm freshness or diagnose an upstream_unavailable error (an unbuilt/unavailable local index). Signature: get_diagnostics().

tools.name: resolve_term
tools.description: Resolve a phenotype label, synonym, HP id (HP:0000118), or external cross-reference CURIE (UMLS:C0000737, SNOMEDCT_US:263681008, ...) to the canonical HPO term {hpo_id, name, match_type}. For 2 or more terms, call resolve_terms_batch once instead of calling this tool per item. An ambiguous label returns ambiguous_query with candidates (each {hpo_id, name}); an obsolete HP id resolves with success:true, obsolete:true, and its successor in replaced_by. This is the recommended first step — resolve any query to a canonical HP id before calling get_term. Returns the single best match; text queries add other_matches_count, and to list every term matching a text use search_terms. Signature: resolve_term(query, response_mode=).

query.description: A phenotype label, synonym, HP id (HP:0000118), or external xref CURIE (UMLS:C0036572, SNOMEDCT_US:263681008, ...).

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal|compact|standard|full (default compact).

tools.name: resolve_terms_batch
tools.description: Resolve many phenotype labels, synonyms, HP ids or xref CURIEs in one call (label -> HP id and HP id -> label); returns one results[] row per input in input order: {index, query, ok: true, hpo_id, name, match_type} or {index, ok: false, error_code, message} (an ambiguous label adds candidates). One bad item never fails the call; unresolved_count says how many missed. Max 100 items. Signature: resolve_terms_batch(queries, response_mode=).

queries.description: 1..100 phenotype labels/synonyms, HP ids, or xref CURIEs.

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal|compact|standard|full (default compact).

tools.name: search_terms
tools.description: Full-text search over HPO phenotype term names, synonyms, and definitions (FTS, relevance-ranked); returns {hpo_id, name, score} -- compact adds a short definition_snippet; standard/full add the complete definition -- plus a pagination block {total, returned, limit, offset, truncated, next_offset}. When truncated, next_commands carries a forward-page step (offset advanced) and a widen step. Obsolete terms are excluded unless include_obsolete=true. Signature: search_terms(query, limit=, offset=, include_obsolete=, response_mode=).

query.description: A phenotype label, synonym, HP id (HP:0000118), or external xref CURIE (UMLS:C0036572, SNOMEDCT_US:263681008, ...).

offset.description: Rows to skip for forward paging (default 0).

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal|compact|standard|full (default compact).

tools.name: get_term
tools.description: Return an HPO phenotype term record: definition, synonyms (exact/related/broad/narrow), alt_ids, subsets, comments, cross-references, direct parents and children, and obsolescence (replaced_by). The term accepts an HP id, a label/synonym, or an external xref CURIE (resolved first). For only the labels of several HP ids, call resolve_terms_batch once. Pass fields=['synonyms', 'definition'] for a sparse projection. Note on synonyms shape: compact (default) returns synonyms as plain strings; standard/full return {text, scope} objects. Signature: get_term(hpo_id, response_mode=, fields=).

hpo_id.description: Canonical HP id for the resolved HPO term (HP:0000118). Legacy `term` arguments are accepted as an alias.

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal|compact|standard|full (default compact).

fields.description: Sparse fieldset: return ONLY these top-level keys (for map_cross_ontology, dot into the grouped object, e.g. 'mappings.UMLS'). Identity anchors (hpo_id, name, hpo_version) are always included. An unrecognised field is rejected with invalid_input. Omit for the full payload.

tools.name: get_term_ancestors
tools.description: Return all transitive is_a ancestors (broader phenotype terms) of an HPO term via the precomputed closure, with a pagination block {total, returned, limit, offset, truncated, next_offset}. When truncated, next_commands carries a forward-page step (offset) so you can walk a >limit closure without re-sending rows. Use get_term_parents for only the immediate parents. Signature: get_term_ancestors(hpo_id, limit=, offset=, response_mode=).

hpo_id.description: Canonical HP id for the resolved HPO term (HP:0000118). Legacy `term` arguments are accepted as an alias.

offset.description: Rows to skip for forward paging (default 0).

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal|compact|standard|full (default compact).

tools.name: get_term_descendants
tools.description: Return all transitive is_a descendants (more specific phenotype terms) of an HPO term via the precomputed closure, with a pagination block {total, returned, limit, offset, truncated, next_offset}. When truncated, next_commands carries a forward-page step (offset) so you can walk a >limit closure without re-sending rows. Use get_term_children for only the immediate children. Signature: get_term_descendants(hpo_id, limit=, offset=, response_mode=).

hpo_id.description: Canonical HP id for the resolved HPO term (HP:0000118). Legacy `term` arguments are accepted as an alias.

offset.description: Rows to skip for forward paging (default 0).

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal|compact|standard|full (default compact).

tools.name: get_term_parents
tools.description: Return the direct is_a parents (immediate broader phenotype terms) of an HPO term. Use get_term_ancestors for the full transitive set. Signature: get_term_parents(hpo_id, response_mode=).

hpo_id.description: Canonical HP id for the resolved HPO term (HP:0000118). Legacy `term` arguments are accepted as an alias.

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal|compact|standard|full (default compact).

tools.name: get_term_children
tools.description: Return the direct is_a children (immediate more-specific phenotype terms) of an HPO term. Use get_term_descendants for the full transitive set. Signature: get_term_children(hpo_id, response_mode=).

hpo_id.description: Canonical HP id for the resolved HPO term (HP:0000118). Legacy `term` arguments are accepted as an alias.

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal|compact|standard|full (default compact).

tools.name: resolve_xref
tools.description: Resolve an external cross-reference CURIE (UMLS/SNOMEDCT_US/NCIT/MEDDRA/ICD-10/ICD-9/MONDO/DOID/ORPHA) back to the HPO term(s) that cross-reference it. Returns results[] plus a pagination block {total, returned, limit, offset, truncated, next_offset}; when truncated, next_commands carries a forward-page step (offset). Signature: resolve_xref(xref_id, limit=, offset=, response_mode=).

xref_id.description: An external cross-reference CURIE (prefix:local) present in the selected HPO release, such as NCIT or MEDDRA, to resolve back to matching HPO terms.

offset.description: Rows to skip for forward paging (default 0).

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal|compact|standard|full (default compact).

tools.name: map_cross_ontology
tools.description: List an HPO term's cross-references to other ontologies/vocabularies, grouped by target prefix (UMLS/SNOMEDCT_US/NCIT/MEDDRA/ICD-10/ICD-9/MONDO/DOID/ORPHA/EFO/MSH/MESH). Optionally restrict to a subset of prefixes. Signature: map_cross_ontology(hpo_id, prefixes=, response_mode=, fields=).

hpo_id.description: Canonical HP id for the resolved HPO term (HP:0000118). Legacy `term` arguments are accepted as an alias.

prefixes.description: Restrict to these target prefixes, e.g. ['UMLS','SNOMEDCT_US'].

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal|compact|standard|full (default compact).

fields.description: Sparse fieldset: return ONLY these top-level keys (for map_cross_ontology, dot into the grouped object, e.g. 'mappings.UMLS'). Identity anchors (hpo_id, name, hpo_version) are always included. An unrecognised field is rejected with invalid_input. Omit for the full payload.

tools.name: get_phenotypes_for_gene
tools.description: Return the HPO phenotype terms annotated to a gene (symbol or NCBI id). Signature: get_phenotypes_for_gene(gene, limit=, offset=, response_mode=). For several phenotypes and/or a candidate gene list at once, use score_genes_for_phenotypes instead of looping over single-gene calls.

gene.description: A gene symbol (e.g. 'PAX6') or NCBI gene CURIE (e.g. 'NCBIGene:5080'). Bare NCBI numeric ids (e.g. '5080') are also accepted. Ensembl gene (ENSG...), RefSeq and HGNC ids are rejected: translate them with hgnc_resolve_symbol first. Transcript ids (ENST...) are not gene ids.

offset.description: Rows to skip for forward paging (default 0).

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal|compact|standard|full (default compact).

tools.name: get_genes_for_phenotype
tools.description: Return the genes annotated to an HPO phenotype term, optionally expanded to include descendants. Signature: get_genes_for_phenotype(hpo_id, include_descendants=, limit=, offset=, response_mode=). For several phenotypes and/or a candidate gene list at once, use score_genes_for_phenotypes instead of looping over single-term calls.

hpo_id.description: Canonical HP id for the resolved HPO phenotype (HP:0000118). Legacy `term` arguments are accepted as an alias.

include_descendants.description: When true, unions the term's transitive descendants so genes annotated to any child term are included (default false).

offset.description: Rows to skip for forward paging (default 0).

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal|compact|standard|full (default compact).

tools.name: get_phenotypes_for_disease
tools.description: Return the HPO phenotype terms annotated to a disease CURIE (e.g. OMIM:106210, ORPHA:550). Signature: get_phenotypes_for_disease(disease_id, limit=, offset=, response_mode=).

disease_id.description: A disease CURIE: 'OMIM:106210', 'ORPHA:550' (Orphanet) or 'DECIPHER:16'; the 'MIM:' and 'Orphanet:' spellings are accepted. MONDO and other ontology ids are rejected: convert them with mondo_map_cross_ontology first.

offset.description: Rows to skip for forward paging (default 0).

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal|compact|standard|full (default compact).

tools.name: get_diseases_for_phenotype
tools.description: Return diseases annotated to an HPO phenotype term, optionally expanded to include descendants. Signature: get_diseases_for_phenotype(hpo_id, include_descendants=, limit=, offset=, response_mode=).

hpo_id.description: Canonical HP id for the resolved HPO phenotype (HP:0000118). Legacy `term` arguments are accepted as an alias.

include_descendants.description: When true, unions the term's transitive descendants so diseases annotated to any child term are included (default false).

offset.description: Rows to skip for forward paging (default 0).

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal|compact|standard|full (default compact).

tools.name: get_genes_for_disease
tools.description: Return genes associated with a disease CURIE (e.g. OMIM:106210, ORPHA:550). Signature: get_genes_for_disease(disease_id, limit=, offset=, response_mode=).

disease_id.description: A disease CURIE: 'OMIM:106210', 'ORPHA:550' (Orphanet) or 'DECIPHER:16'; the 'MIM:' and 'Orphanet:' spellings are accepted. MONDO and other ontology ids are rejected: convert them with mondo_map_cross_ontology first.

offset.description: Rows to skip for forward paging (default 0).

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal|compact|standard|full (default compact).

tools.name: get_diseases_for_gene
tools.description: Return diseases associated with a gene (symbol or NCBI id). Signature: get_diseases_for_gene(gene, limit=, offset=, response_mode=).

gene.description: A gene symbol (e.g. 'PAX6') or NCBI gene CURIE (e.g. 'NCBIGene:5080'). Bare NCBI numeric ids (e.g. '5080') are also accepted. Ensembl gene (ENSG...), RefSeq and HGNC ids are rejected: translate them with hgnc_resolve_symbol first. Transcript ids (ENST...) are not gene ids.

offset.description: Rows to skip for forward paging (default 0).

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal|compact|standard|full (default compact).

tools.name: score_genes_for_phenotypes
tools.description: Rank genes for a set of HPO phenotype terms (Resnik similarity to annotated diseases); returns ranked candidate genes for a patient's phenotypes, each with score, best disease and matched term pairs (shared ancestor + IC); excluded terms are reported as conflicts, never scored. Every input HP id is scored as given, listed in replaced_hpo_ids (obsolete id or alt_id, scored as replaced_by) or listed in ignored_hpo_ids with a reason. close_call=true (with rank1_margin) means the top ranks are too close to pick rank 1 by score alone; close_call=false does not confirm rank 1. In minimal mode top_matches reads '<input id> = <disease term>' for the same term, '~' for a related one, f=? when no frequency is recorded. Signature: score_genes_for_phenotypes(hpo_ids, excluded_hpo_ids=, candidate_genes=, limit=, offset=, response_mode=).

hpo_ids.description: Present patient phenotypes as HP ids (e.g. HP:0001250).

excluded_hpo_ids.description: Phenotypes observed ABSENT. Reported as conflicts on each gene's best disease; they never lower a score.

candidate_genes.description: Restrict ranking to these genes (e.g. genes with exome variants): gene symbols (SCN1A) or NCBI gene ids (NCBIGene:6323 or 6323). Ensembl gene (ENSG...), HGNC (HGNC:...) and RefSeq ids are not mapped here: translate the list with hgnc_resolve_symbols_batch first (transcript ids, ENST..., are not gene ids). Each ranked row echoes the caller's spelling as input_id; entries that cannot be ranked are listed in unranked_candidate_genes as {input_id, reason} (unsupported_identifier | not_rankable).

offset.description: Rows to skip for forward paging (default 0).

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal|compact|standard|full (default compact).

tools.name: get_server_capabilities
tools.description: Get server version, MetaDome build (GRCh37/GRCh38), tools, limits, error codes and the canonical workflow. Returns no gene data; for a gene start with resolve_transcript.

tools.name: get_diagnostics
tools.description: Get cache stats, request metrics and data versions of this server. Use to debug failing calls; returns no gene data (server scope: get_server_capabilities).

tools.name: resolve_transcript
tools.description: Resolve a gene symbol or versioned ENST id to the MetaDome transcript (GRCh37 or GRCh38 build) to use for its missense tolerance landscape; for a gene returns its transcripts and canonical_transcript_id (MANE Select, else longest analyzable). Use first, then request_tolerance_landscape.

query.description: HGNC gene symbol (e.g. TP53) or versioned ENST id.

response_mode.description: Output verbosity; default compact, minimal = essentials only.

tools.name: request_tolerance_landscape
tools.description: Start the MetaDome tolerance-landscape build for a transcript (async, idempotent); returns job_id and status ready or processing. Cold builds can take up to ~1 h. Every read tool needs this first; then poll get_tolerance_landscape.

transcript_id.description: Versioned Ensembl transcript id (with .N suffix), from resolve_transcript.

response_mode.description: Output verbosity; default compact, minimal = essentials only.

tools.name: get_tolerance_landscape
tools.description: Get per-residue missense tolerance (sw_dn_ds, lower = more intolerant) and Pfam domains for a transcript, paginated. Call request_tolerance_landscape first. status processing with poll_after_s is not an error: wait and poll again. not_found = MetaDome has no landscape or build job for the id.

transcript_id.description: Versioned Ensembl transcript id (with .N suffix), from resolve_transcript.

position_start.description: 1-based protein residue position; range bounds are inclusive.

position_stop.description: 1-based protein residue position; range bounds are inclusive.

offset.description: Rows to skip; pass the previous pagination.next_offset.

response_mode.description: Output verbosity; default compact, minimal = essentials only.

tools.name: get_position_tolerance
tools.description: Get the tolerance score, Pfam domain and ClinVar variants at one protein residue. Needs a built landscape (request_tolerance_landscape). For several residues use compare_positions.

transcript_id.description: Versioned Ensembl transcript id (with .N suffix), from resolve_transcript.

response_mode.description: Output verbosity; default compact, minimal = essentials only.

tools.name: get_variant_counts
tools.description: Get residue ClinVar variants plus Pfam meta-domain homolog aggregates for one residue or a range. Aggregates can include other genes; MetaDome has no per-residue gnomAD counts. Needs a built landscape (request_tolerance_landscape).

transcript_id.description: Versioned Ensembl transcript id (with .N suffix), from resolve_transcript.

position.description: 1-based protein residue position; range bounds are inclusive.

position_start.description: 1-based protein residue position; range bounds are inclusive.

position_stop.description: 1-based protein residue position; range bounds are inclusive.

source.description: Variant evidence to include: gnomad, clinvar or both.

offset.description: Rows to skip; pass the previous pagination.next_offset.

response_mode.description: Output verbosity; default compact, minimal = essentials only.

tools.name: compare_positions
tools.description: Compare several residues of one transcript; returns a side-by-side tolerance, domain and ClinVar table. Needs a built landscape (request_tolerance_landscape). For one residue use get_position_tolerance.

transcript_id.description: Versioned Ensembl transcript id (with .N suffix), from resolve_transcript.

response_mode.description: Output verbosity; default compact, minimal = essentials only.

tools.name: get_protein_domains
tools.description: List Pfam domains (id, name, residue range) of a transcript. Needs a built landscape (request_tolerance_landscape). Then get_meta_domain for homolog variants.

transcript_id.description: Versioned Ensembl transcript id (with .N suffix), from resolve_transcript.

response_mode.description: Output verbosity; default compact, minimal = essentials only.

tools.name: get_meta_domain
tools.description: Get variants at the aligned position of homologous Pfam domains (meta-domain) for one residue; these span other genes, not this gene alone. Needs a built landscape (request_tolerance_landscape). Paginated.

transcript_id.description: Versioned Ensembl transcript id (with .N suffix), from resolve_transcript.

domains.description: Optional {Pfam id: [consensus positions]} selector; omit to use the residue's own domains.

offset.description: Rows to skip; pass the previous pagination.next_offset.

response_mode.description: Output verbosity; default compact, minimal = essentials only.

tools.name: summarize_intolerant_regions
tools.description: Find ranked runs of missense-intolerant residues (sw_dn_ds below threshold) with Pfam overlap and scoped variant evidence. Needs a built landscape (request_tolerance_landscape). For raw per-residue scores use get_tolerance_landscape.

transcript_id.description: Versioned Ensembl transcript id (with .N suffix), from resolve_transcript.

threshold.description: sw_dn_ds cutoff in (0, 2]; residues below it count as intolerant.

min_run.description: Minimum consecutive intolerant residues per region.

top_n.description: Maximum regions returned, most intolerant first.

response_mode.description: Output verbosity; default compact, minimal = essentials only.

tools.name: get_server_capabilities
tools.description: Return the orphanet-link discovery surface: identity/build/Orphanet release, the tool list WITH call signatures, response modes, recommended workflows, the cross-reference source ranking, the error taxonomy, and limits. detail='full' adds the full policy notes. Call this first in a cold session, or read orphanet://tools / orphanet://capabilities. Signature: get_server_capabilities(detail=).

detail.description: summary (default, light) or full (adds policy notes).

tools.name: get_diagnostics
tools.description: Report the local Orphanet index status: whether the data is built, the loaded Orphanet release version, disorder counts, schema version, and when it was built, plus a runtime block (request/error counts, latency percentiles p50/p95/p99, a response_mode distribution that surfaces over-fetch, and a version-hash cache hit/miss ratio). Use this to confirm freshness or diagnose a data_unavailable error. Signature: get_diagnostics().

tools.name: resolve_disease
tools.description: Resolve a disease label, synonym, ORPHAcode (ORPHA:166024 or 166024), or cross-reference CURIE (OMIM:607131, MONDO:0006516, ICD-10, ICD-11, UMLS, MeSH, GARD, MedDRA) to the canonical Orphanet term {orpha_code, name, match_type}. For 2 or more queries, call resolve_disease_batch once instead of calling this tool per item. A bare number is read as an ORPHAcode; prefix an OMIM number (OMIM:163950). An ambiguous label returns ambiguous_query with candidates. Signature: resolve_disease(query, response_mode=).

query.description: A disease label, synonym, ORPHAcode (ORPHA:166024 or 166024), or cross-reference CURIE (OMIM:607131, MONDO:0006516). A bare number is an ORPHAcode.

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal|compact|standard|full (default compact).

tools.name: search_diseases
tools.description: Full-text search over Orphanet disease names, synonyms, and definitions (FTS, relevance-ranked); returns {orpha_code, name, score} plus top-level pagination fields {total, returned, limit, offset, truncated, next_offset}. When truncated, next_commands carries a forward-page step. Obsolete terms are excluded unless include_obsolete=true. Signature: search_diseases(query, limit=, offset=, include_obsolete=, response_mode=).

query.description: A disease label, synonym, ORPHAcode (ORPHA:166024 or 166024), or cross-reference CURIE (OMIM:607131, MONDO:0006516). A bare number is an ORPHAcode.

offset.description: Rows to skip for forward paging (default 0).

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal|compact|standard|full (default compact).

tools.name: get_disease
tools.description: Return an Orphanet disease record: definition, synonyms, grouped cross-references, classification parents/children, age of onset, inheritance, and disorder type. For 2 or more terms, call get_disease_batch once instead of calling this tool per item. The term accepts an ORPHAcode, a label/synonym, or an external xref CURIE (resolved first; a bare number is read as an ORPHAcode, so prefix an OMIM number: OMIM:163950). xrefs are grouped by source; any nested count is leaf rows, not groups. Pass fields=['xrefs.OMIM', ...] for a sparse projection, or include=['genes','phenotypes','prevalence','disability'] to compose a full entity in ONE call. Signature: get_disease(term, response_mode=, fields=, include=).

term.description: An ORPHAcode (ORPHA:33069 or 33069), a disease label/synonym, or an external xref CURIE that resolves to a single Orphanet term.

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal|compact|standard|full (default compact).

fields.description: Sparse fieldset: return ONLY these top-level keys (dot into a grouped object, e.g. 'xrefs.OMIM'). Identity anchors (orpha_code, name, orphanet_version) are always included. Omit for the full payload.

include.description: Compose extra association sections into the single record (any of: genes, phenotypes, prevalence, disability) so a full entity needs one call instead of a per-section fan-out. Omit for the base record only.

tools.name: get_disease_genes
tools.description: Return gene-disease associations for an Orphanet disorder: gene symbol, HGNC id, association type, and cross-references (OMIM, Ensembl, etc.). count is the number of leaf gene rows, not grouped associations. A group term with no direct genes returns count 0 plus descendant_count; call get_disease_descendants and query the subtypes. Signature: get_disease_genes(term, response_mode=).

term.description: An ORPHAcode (ORPHA:33069 or 33069), a disease label/synonym, or an external xref CURIE that resolves to a single Orphanet term.

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal|compact|standard|full (default compact).

tools.name: get_disease_phenotypes
tools.description: Return HPO phenotype annotations for an Orphanet disorder: HPO id, term name, and frequency category. Optionally filter by frequency label. Frequency values: Obligate (100%), Very frequent (99-80%), Frequent (79-30%), Occasional (29-5%) (and others). Signature: get_disease_phenotypes(term, frequency=, response_mode=).

term.description: An ORPHAcode (ORPHA:33069 or 33069), a disease label/synonym, or an external xref CURIE that resolves to a single Orphanet term.

frequency.description: Filter by HPO frequency bucket. A CLOSED vocabulary (see the enum): the label must match exactly, including its percentage range -- 'Frequent' is not 'Frequent (79-30%)'. An unrecognised label is rejected with invalid_input, never silently matched to nothing. Omit to return all.

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal|compact|standard|full (default compact).

tools.name: get_disease_prevalence
tools.description: Return prevalence data for an Orphanet disorder: prevalence class, geographic area, and source reference. Signature: get_disease_prevalence(term, response_mode=).

term.description: An ORPHAcode (ORPHA:33069 or 33069), a disease label/synonym, or an external xref CURIE that resolves to a single Orphanet term.

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal|compact|standard|full (default compact).

tools.name: get_disease_natural_history
tools.description: Return natural history data for an Orphanet disorder: age of onset categories and inheritance patterns. Signature: get_disease_natural_history(term, response_mode=).

term.description: An ORPHAcode (ORPHA:33069 or 33069), a disease label/synonym, or an external xref CURIE that resolves to a single Orphanet term.

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal|compact|standard|full (default compact).

tools.name: get_disease_disability
tools.description: Return functional consequence (disability) data for an Orphanet disorder: ability categories affected and severity grades. Data coverage is partial: many disorders carry no Orphadata functional-consequence annotation, so a valid result can be empty -- coverage:'none' with count:0 marks this explicitly (it is NOT an error); coverage:'present' means rows exist. Signature: get_disease_disability(term, response_mode=).

term.description: An ORPHAcode (ORPHA:33069 or 33069), a disease label/synonym, or an external xref CURIE that resolves to a single Orphanet term.

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal|compact|standard|full (default compact).

tools.name: find_diseases_by_gene
tools.description: Find all Orphanet disorders associated with a gene, given as an HGNC symbol, an HGNC id (HGNC:6407) or an Ensembl gene id (ENSG00000133703). Returns {orpha_code, name} per disorder with pagination; an id is matched on Orphanet's own gene cross-references and echoed as resolved_from. Other gene id forms return invalid_input: RefSeq and NCBI Gene ids name the hgnc converter, a transcript id does not convert. Signature: find_diseases_by_gene(gene_symbol, limit=, offset=, response_mode=).

gene_symbol.description: HGNC gene symbol, e.g. 'KIF7' or 'HNF1B'; an HGNC id ('HGNC:6407') or Ensembl gene id ('ENSG00000133703') is also accepted.

offset.description: Rows to skip for forward paging (default 0).

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal|compact|standard|full (default compact).

tools.name: find_diseases_by_phenotype
tools.description: Find all Orphanet disorders annotated with an HPO term id. Returns {orpha_code, name} per disorder with pagination. A phenotype label is not accepted (invalid_input): get its id from hpo_resolve_term first. Signature: find_diseases_by_phenotype(hpo_id, limit=, offset=, response_mode=).

hpo_id.description: HPO term id (HP: + seven digits), e.g. 'HP:0000256'; not a label.

offset.description: Rows to skip for forward paging (default 0).

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal|compact|standard|full (default compact).

tools.name: get_disease_classification
tools.description: Return the immediate Orphanet classification parents and children for a disorder. Use get_disease_ancestors / get_disease_descendants for the transitive closure. Signature: get_disease_classification(term, response_mode=).

term.description: An ORPHAcode (ORPHA:33069 or 33069), a disease label/synonym, or an external xref CURIE that resolves to a single Orphanet term.

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal|compact|standard|full (default compact).

tools.name: get_disease_ancestors
tools.description: Return all transitive ancestors (broader diseases) of an Orphanet disorder via the precomputed closure, with a pagination block {total, returned, limit, offset, truncated, next_offset}. When truncated, next_commands carries a forward-page step. Use get_disease_classification for only the immediate parents. Signature: get_disease_ancestors(term, limit=, offset=, response_mode=).

term.description: An ORPHAcode (ORPHA:33069 or 33069), a disease label/synonym, or an external xref CURIE that resolves to a single Orphanet term.

offset.description: Rows to skip for forward paging (default 0).

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal|compact|standard|full (default compact).

tools.name: get_disease_descendants
tools.description: Return all transitive descendants (more specific diseases) of an Orphanet disorder via the precomputed closure, with a pagination block {total, returned, limit, offset, truncated, next_offset}. When truncated, next_commands carries a forward-page step. Use get_disease_classification for only the immediate children. Signature: get_disease_descendants(term, limit=, offset=, response_mode=).

term.description: An ORPHAcode, label, or xref CURIE for a grouping/category term (a specific disease is a leaf and has no descendants).

offset.description: Rows to skip for forward paging (default 0).

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal|compact|standard|full (default compact).

tools.name: resolve_xref
tools.description: Resolve an external cross-reference CURIE (OMIM/MONDO/ICD-10/ICD-11/UMLS/GARD/MeSH/MedDRA) back to the Orphanet disorder(s) that map to it. Returns results[] plus a pagination block {total, returned, limit, offset, truncated, next_offset}; when truncated, next_commands carries a forward-page step. Miss semantics (list-shaped, unlike resolve_disease): a malformed CURIE is rejected with invalid_input, while a well-formed but unmapped CURIE returns an empty page (total: 0), not not_found. Signature: resolve_xref(xref_id, limit=, offset=, response_mode=).

xref_id.description: An external cross-reference CURIE (prefix:local), e.g. OMIM/MONDO/ICD-10, to resolve back to the Orphanet term(s) that map to it.

offset.description: Rows to skip for forward paging (default 0).

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal|compact|standard|full (default compact).

tools.name: map_cross_ontology
tools.description: List an Orphanet disorder's cross-references to other ontologies, grouped by source (OMIM/MONDO/ICD-10/ICD-11/UMLS/GARD/MeSH/MedDRA), each with its mapping relation. Returns them under `result` (get_disease returns the same data under `result.xrefs`). Use prefixes=['OMIM'] to restrict to a subset of sources. count is the number of leaf mapping rows (individual targets), not the number of source groups. Signature: map_cross_ontology(term, prefixes=, response_mode=).

term.description: An ORPHAcode (ORPHA:33069 or 33069), a disease label/synonym, or an external xref CURIE that resolves to a single Orphanet term.

prefixes.description: Restrict the cross-reference sources returned to this subset (any of the xref sources: OMIM/MONDO/ICD-10/ICD-11/UMLS/GARD/MeSH/MedDRA). Omit to return every source.

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal|compact|standard|full (default compact).

tools.name: resolve_disease_batch
tools.description: Resolve many labels/ORPHAcodes/xrefs in one call (partial success: each item returns its resolution {orpha_code, name, match_type} or its own ok=false/error_code/message; the call never fails wholesale). Max 50 items; compact per item. Signature: resolve_disease_batch(queries, response_mode=).

queries.description: A LIST of 1..50 disease labels, ORPHAcodes or xref CURIEs to resolve — one entry per item, not a comma-joined string.

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal|compact|standard|full (default compact).

tools.name: get_disease_batch
tools.description: Fetch many disease records in one call (partial success per item: each row is the record or its own ok=false/error_code/message). Each term accepts an ORPHAcode, label, or xref CURIE; pass fields=[...] for a sparse projection. Max 50 items; compact per item. Signature: get_disease_batch(terms, response_mode=, fields=).

terms.description: A LIST of 1..50 ORPHAcodes, disease labels or xref CURIEs to fetch — one entry per item, not a comma-joined string.

response_mode.description: Verbosity: minimal|compact|standard|full (default compact).

fields.description: Sparse fieldset: return ONLY these top-level keys (dot into a grouped object, e.g. 'xrefs.OMIM'). Identity anchors (orpha_code, name, orphanet_version) are always included. Omit for the full payload.

tools.name: resolve_trait
tools.description: Find PGS Catalog traits by name, synonym or current ontology ID (EFO/MONDO/HP) and return each trait's id (the trait_id other tools take) with its categories, match (label, synonym or partial; a hint flags several exact matches), score_count (scores mapped directly) and score_count_with_descendants (direct + descendant traits; what search_scores(include_children=true) returns). Start here: other tools need the catalog's trait_id. Retired IDs are not mapped: search by name. No label or synonym match is not_found, with partial hits as candidates (match: weak). Signature: resolve_trait(query, limit=, offset=).

query.description: Trait name, synonym or ontology ID, e.g. 'type 2 diabetes'.

offset.description: Rows to skip; use the previous `next_offset`.

tools.name: get_trait
tools.description: Return one trait: label, synonyms, categories, description, score counts and the first 50 PGS IDs mapped to it (pgs_ids_truncated says if there are more: page them with search_scores(trait_id)); include_children adds descendant traits and their score IDs. An unknown or retired ID is not_found. Signature: get_trait(trait_id, include_children=).

trait_id.description: Trait ontology ID as the catalog writes it (MONDO_0004989, EFO_0001645, HP_0000822). Get it from resolve_trait; old EFO IDs migrated to MONDO are not_found.

include_children.description: Also list descendant traits and their scores.

tools.name: search_scores
tools.description: List polygenic scores matching ALL given selectors: trait_id (+include_children), publication_id or pmid, pgs_ids; none lists the whole catalog. Rows are in PGS ID order (pgs_ids alone keeps your order). Each row: trait, method, variant count, genome build, ancestry % per stage (gwas/dev/eval; codes in get_server_capabilities.ancestry_legend; no `dev` = no separate development sample reported) and source publication. Rows under the catalog's standard terms omit `license` (stated once as license_default); any other licence is shown on its row verbatim. `total` is exact; page with offset. Signature: search_scores(trait_id=, include_children=, publication_id=, pmid=, pgs_ids=, response_mode=, limit=, offset=).

anyOf.description: Trait ontology ID as the catalog writes it (MONDO_0004989, EFO_0001645, HP_0000822). Get it from resolve_trait; old EFO IDs migrated to MONDO are not_found.

trait_id.description: Scores mapped to this trait (from resolve_trait).

include_children.description: With trait_id: also scores of descendant traits.

anyOf.description: PGS Catalog publication ID: PGP + 6 digits.

publication_id.description: Scores developed or evaluated in this PGP publication.

pmid.description: Scores developed or evaluated in this PubMed paper.

items.description: PGS Catalog score ID: PGS + 6 digits.

tools.name: get_score
tools.description: Return full metadata of one polygenic score: traits, method and parameters, variant count and genome build, GWAS/training samples with ancestry, the author-set licence, source publication, and download links for the original and harmonized (GRCh37/GRCh38) scoring files. variants_number counts the original file; harmonized files may map fewer. Weights are not inlined, and this server does not compute scores (use the files with the catalog's pgsc_calc). Signature: get_score(pgs_id).

pgs_id.description: PGS Catalog score ID: PGS + 6 digits.

tools.name: get_score_performance
tools.description: Return the published performance metrics of one score: effect sizes (OR/HR/beta), classification accuracy (AUROC, C-index) and other metrics, each with its evaluation sample set (size, cases/controls, ancestry, cohorts) and covariates, in PPM ID order. publication_id keeps only the records from one paper (e.g. the score's source publication from get_score). The default response_mode=compact gives metrics with short names and lists each evaluation sample set once (samplesets, keyed by the row's sampleset ID); standard/full add the samples inline and the fenced prose. limit=1 just reads `total`. A score with no published metrics returns total 0; an unknown score or publication is not_found. Signature: get_score_performance(pgs_id, publication_id=, response_mode=, limit=, offset=).

pgs_id.description: PGS Catalog score ID: PGS + 6 digits.

anyOf.description: PGS Catalog publication ID: PGP + 6 digits.

publication_id.description: Only records from this PGP publication.

response_mode.description: minimal: record and sampleset IDs with metrics | compact (default): + publication and a page-level samplesets table | standard/full: samples inline (with country) and the fenced phenotype/covariates/comments.

offset.description: Rows to skip; use the previous `next_offset`.

tools.description: Return one PGS Catalog publication by PGP ID or PubMed ID: citation, title, and the PGS IDs it developed and evaluated. A paper the catalog does not index is not_found. Signature: get_publication(publication).

publication.description: PGP publication ID (PGP000001) or a PubMed ID, as a number or a string (25855707).

tools.description: Describe this server: CIViC identifiers, limits, data release, licence, classification axes, rate-limit policy and error codes. Signature: get_server_capabilities().

tools.description: Find CIViC molecular profiles (what evidence attaches to) for a gene + variant name (BRAF V600E), a ClinGen CAID (CA123643), a ClinVar variation ID (376069) or an HGVS string, and return exact_match (the single-variant profile) plus `simple` and `complex` lists kept apart: a complex profile (V600E AND MSI Low) only applies to that combination. Each row: id, name, evidence counts; simple_total and complex_total count the whole result. Start here. Signature: search_molecular_profiles(query, limit=, offset=).

offset.description: Rows to skip; use the previous `next_offset`.
